title: Mixing: Ram by Paul and Linda McCartney | 1971
content:
Studio B, Sound Recorders Studio, Los Angeles
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Eirik Wangberg

The final week of mixing for the Ram album began on 12 April 1971.

The mixes were created by studio engineer Eirik Wangberg. Paul and Linda McCartney were mostly absent during the week.

Page last updated: 13 November 2025

  • 1963: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
